name: Slaughter Hollow
summary: Crushridge ogres keep to Slaughter Hollow in the snowy heights of the Alterac Mountains. Travelers come rarely, usually to hunt ogres or cross the frozen passes.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres
sections.body: High in the peaks between Hillsbrad and Alterac, Slaughter Hollow shelters the Crushridge ogres. Makeshift fires, scattered bones, and crude shelters mark their mound. Other ogre dens in the highlands often see fights over territory or stolen supplies. Slaughter Hollow stays quiet, beyond the reach of major military campaigns.

sections.title: Captives and Travelers
sections.body: Crushridge ogres sometimes hold prisoners taken along the mountain trails in their secluded mound. Travelers speak of Rizz Loosebolt, an unlucky gnome locked in a crude cage who tries to bargain with anyone passing by. Captives seldom fare well against the clan's appetite.

faq.answer: Crushridge ogres keep an encampment high in the Alterac Mountains at Slaughter Hollow. Crude shelters and fires mark their mound.
Crushridge ogres live in Slaughter Hollow. The clan also holds the nearby ruins of Alterac City and outposts in the surrounding lands.
No formal assignments send travelers directly to Slaughter Hollow. The den lies out of the way among the mountain paths.

faq.q: Who was the gnome caged here?
faq.answer: Rizz Loosebolt is a gnome held in a cage inside Slaughter Hollow. He offers wares to anyone who finds him.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can take Rizz Loosebolt's capture by the Crushridge as a warning. Tinkerers and scouts who cross the Alterac passes unprepared are at risk.
